sources.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
sources.verified_scope: Equations3–4 provide reward-minus-forward-KL objective and reference-times-exponential-reward optimum. Our categorical exact expected-utility head fitting is not DPO; the square-root beta update is our bounded heuristic, not a cited convergence guarantee.
